capabilities: copy the publish URL of the current view
open the publish URL of the current view
disambiguation: Not a publishing tool; it only builds and copies the public URL for notes already published through Obsidian Publish.
extras: At the time of writing the plugin was not yet approved in the community plugin list; installation is via BRAT or manual git clone and build.
intentEvidence: This plugin helps you to copy and open your publish url quickly.
problem: Obsidian Publish gives no quick way to grab or open the published URL of the note you are currently viewing.
summary: Utility that copies or opens the Obsidian Publish URL of the current note, respecting permalinks, after a one-time domain setup.
